messages:
maya (VP People): follow-up to today's all-hands re: hiring, org tweaks, and onboarding expectations. putting a short FAQ here so managers have a single place to point folks.

maya (VP People): headline: 28 new headcount this FY. Q2 burst focuses on serving/runtime + infra; Q3 expands product & devex. no involuntary cuts.

lisa (People Ops): recruiter note: we're shifting 3 recruiters to the Q2 burst. expect req templates + role-specific bars in #recruiting by EOD.

maria (recruiting): internal fast-track for Redwood employees: shortened loop + 1:1 manager sync. apply internally via Workday -> tag Hiring Manager.

sam (CTO): hiring signal: prioritize candidates who shipped inference features at scale. CUDA/quantization is a plus but systems + production debugging experience is primary.

jordan (eng-manager): onboarding concern: can we get a 30/60/90 checklist aligned to team SLOs so new hires contribute faster?

maya (VP People): yes  People Ops + Eng Ops will publish a joint 30/60/90 template and buddy program guidance. managers: fill the team-specific SLOs before offer accepted.

kai (IC): oncall & rotations question: will new hires be added to rotations immediately?

sam (CTO): nope  shadowing for 6 weeks min. exceptions for senior hires are negotiable. we'll monitor pager load and hire SREs if metrics warrant.

alex (product): product ask: will PMs be hired during Q2 burst or later? we need PMs to define acceptance criteria for platform features.

maya (VP People): 2 platform PMs are in Q2; Dedicated PM in Q3. Product briefs incoming.

lisa (People Ops): offer SLA: aim to close senior offers within 6 weeks, mid/junior 4-6 weeks. interview debriefs: hiring manager must submit decision within 48h of final loop.

maria (recruiting): we'll post a read-only pipeline tracker (no PII) and weekly recruiting sync invites for hiring managers.

maya (VP People): manager action items: 1) review rubrics when posted, 2) nominate interviewers, 3) prepare team 30/60/90 SLOs, 4) book buddy for first 2 months.

harper (allhands-bot): :calendar: Event created: "Hiring + Onboarding sync" Mon 09:30  maya, lisa, sam, maria.

maya (VP People): thanks folks. if you have sensitive concerns about reporting changes or role fit, DM Lisa or me directly. we'll keep updates weekly. :sparkles:
